text:
DeployBot: Starting staged rollout: service=inference-api, model=v2.3.1, cohort=APAC, target=8% traffic. Scheduled window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. /deploy start --staged=8% :rocket:
Olivia: seeing the preflight, holding until we confirm no auth regressions from yesterday's patch. :eyes:
Raj: what signal do you want? I can run a quick smoke against auth-proxy and embeddings route.
Priya (oncall): +1 hold from oncall until we validate login SLOs. I pulled auth spike from last night and want a baseline.
Maria: I ran a diff on the eval set vs prod. Small uptick in false negatives for rerank on edge cases, but not huge. Still, worth watching at canary.
Sam: infra noticed memory pressure on a subset of APAC nodes during warmup (p95 mem 88% -> 95%). attaching logs.
MetricsBot: alert: apac-inference.mem.p95 increased by +7pp over baseline at 21:46 UTC — hostpool apac-gpu-7 flagged.
Raj: can we pin canary to subset of instances that are on newer drivers? Or do a rolling warmup slower.
Olivia: prefer pin to driver-stable group for this cut. If mem stays high, we rollback.
Maria: suggestion: start at 2% to validate auth & mem quickly, then bump to 8% after green.
DeployBot: modify rollout: set initial=2% then wait 10m soak, bump=8% if checks pass. Command: `/deploy edit --staged=2% --soak=10m`
Priya (oncall): I'll watch the auth SLOs and confirm within 10m. If we see >2% login-failure delta, call stop.
Sam: infra will throttle the warmup (5s between hotstarts) and watch OOM rate.
Raj: quick check command I ran: `curl -s "https://metrics.internal/query?m=apac_infer_latency_50"` showed no regression for sample keyspace.
Olivia: ok vote: hold -> proceed with 2% initial? React with :thumbsup: to proceed, :thumbsdown: to abort.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
Priya (oncall): :thumbsdown: until auth check completes (will update in ~5m)
DeployBot: rollout edited. Starting at 2% now. Monitoring hooks active: auth-slo, mem-p95, request-5xx-rate.
MetricsBot: auth.login.failure.delta = +0.4% (within threshold 0.5%) at 21:52:13 UTC. mem.p95=91% on apac-gpu-7.
Priya (oncall): auth looks ok for now. mem is high but stable, no OOMs. Green from oncall.
Olivia: with oncall signoff, we can bump to 8% if infra maintains mem below 95% and auth delta <0.5%.
Sam: infra set auto-throttle to engaged. If mem.p95 > 96% we auto-evict and rollback canary nodes.
Raj: proceed to 8% then. I'll keep an eye on rerank eval metric and post if drift.
DeployBot: bump to 8% scheduled now. `/deploy bump --staged=8%`
MetricsBot: at 21:59:04 UTC: rerank.false_neg.delta = +0.9% (threshold 1.0%). auth delta steady 0.2%. mem.p95=92%.
Maria: tiny uptick but below alert. I'm running a quick targeted eval on the failing examples.
Priya (oncall): still green on auth and errors.
Olivia: final check: anyone see anything blocking?
Sam: infra: a single host behind apac-gpu-7 reported transient gRPC retry spikes at 22:00:11; recovering. No action required yet.
Raj: I'm seeing two borderline rerank cases, but I can patch prompt shim if it becomes a problem.
Olivia: consensus: go. Proceeding with full 8% staged rollout and continuing telemetry. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: rollout at 8% complete. Monitoring for 15m, auto-fallback policy enabled (fallback -> model=v2.2.9).
MetricsBot: note: setting webhooks for post-rollout regression eval.
Maria: leaving a pinned note for release notes: "v2.3.1 staged canary APAC 8% — held at 2% for auth/mem checks, bumped to 8% after oncall signoff. Observed minor rerank delta <1%."
Olivia: thanks all. If any of the alerts cross thresholds, call stop/go and we'll rollback.
Priya (oncall): will escalate immediately if auth delta >0.5% or mem.p95 >96%.
Sam: adding runbook snippet to the thread:```
# rollback quick
/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.2.9
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-api --replicas=0 && kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-api --replicas=3
```
Raj: noted. good runbook.
DeployBot: thread closed by automation after 15m stabilization window. If new issues, reopen thread.
